package cache

import (
	"bufio"
	"context"
	"encoding/base64"
	"encoding/json"
	"fmt"
	"math/rand"
	"os"
	"strings"
	"testing"

	"github.com/router-for-me/CLIProxyAPI/v8/internal/signature"
)

// Golden generator for the Rust port: replays seeded random operation sequences against the real
// Go caches and records every result. Run via `go test -overlay`; see crates/core/src/cache/testdata.

type op map[string]any

func strs(items [][]byte) []string {
	if items == nil {
		return nil
	}
	out := make([]string, len(items))
	for i, it := range items {
		out[i] = string(it)
	}
	return out
}

func toBytes(items []string) [][]byte {
	out := make([][]byte, len(items))
	for i, s := range items {
		out[i] = []byte(s)
	}
	return out
}

func gptSig(seed byte) string {
	payload := make([]byte, 1+8+16+16+32)
	payload[0] = 0x80
	for i := 9; i < len(payload); i++ {
		payload[i] = seed + byte(i)
	}
	return base64.RawURLEncoding.EncodeToString(payload)
}

func grokSig(seed int64) string {
	for s := seed; ; s++ {
		buf := make([]byte, 64)
		rand.New(rand.NewSource(s)).Read(buf)
		sig := base64.RawStdEncoding.EncodeToString(buf)
		if _, err := signature.InspectGrokEncryptedContent(sig); err == nil {
			return sig
		}
	}
}

func TestZZCacheGolden(t *testing.T) {
	outPath := os.Getenv("GOLDEN_OUT")
	if outPath == "" {
		t.Skip("GOLDEN_OUT not set")
	}
	f, err := os.Create(outPath)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	defer f.Close()
	w := bufio.NewWriterSize(f, 1<<20)
	defer w.Flush()
	enc := json.NewEncoder(w)
	enc.SetEscapeHTML(false)
	rng := rand.New(rand.NewSource(7))
	ctx := context.Background()

	models := []string{"m1", "m2", " m1 ", ""}
	sessions := []string{"s1", "s2", " s1 ", ""}
	pick := func(xs []string) int { return rng.Intn(len(xs)) }

	// ---- signature cache
	{
		longSig := func(n int) string { return fmt.Sprintf("%050d", n) }
		smodels := []string{"claude-opus", "claude-sonnet", "gpt-5", "gemini-3", "gemini-2.5", "deepseek", "other"}
		texts := []string{"", "hello", "world", "héllo ☃", "hello"}
		for seq := 0; seq < 60; seq++ {
			ClearSignatureCache("")
			var ops []op
			var outs []any
			for i := 0; i < 25; i++ {
				m := smodels[rng.Intn(len(smodels))]
				tx := texts[rng.Intn(len(texts))]
				switch rng.Intn(7) {
				case 0, 1:
					sig := longSig(rng.Intn(5))
					if rng.Intn(4) == 0 {
						sig = []string{"short", strings.Repeat("x", 49), strings.Repeat("y", 50), strings.Repeat("z", 51)}[rng.Intn(4)]
					}
					ops = append(ops, op{"op": "cache", "model": m, "text": tx, "sig": sig})
					outs = append(outs, CacheSignatureBestEffort(ctx, m, tx, sig))
				case 2, 3:
					ops = append(ops, op{"op": "get", "model": m, "text": tx})
					s, e := GetCachedSignatureRequired(ctx, m, tx)
					outs = append(outs, []any{s, e == nil})
				case 4:
					ops = append(ops, op{"op": "delete", "model": m, "text": tx})
					outs = append(outs, DeleteCachedSignatureRequired(ctx, m, tx) == nil)
				case 5:
					clearModel := ""
					if rng.Intn(2) == 0 {
						clearModel = m
					}
					ops = append(ops, op{"op": "clear", "model": clearModel})
					ClearSignatureCache(clearModel)
					outs = append(outs, nil)
				case 6:
					sig := []string{"", "skip_thought_signature_validator", longSig(1), "x"}[rng.Intn(4)]
					ops = append(ops, op{"op": "hasValid", "model": m, "sig": sig})
					outs = append(outs, HasValidSignature(m, sig))
				}
			}
			enc.Encode(op{"cache": "signature", "ops": ops, "out": outs})
		}
		var groups []op
		for _, m := range []string{"gpt-5", "claude-3", "gemini-pro", "foo", "", "my-gpt-claude", "claude-gemini"} {
			groups = append(groups, op{"model": m, "group": GetModelGroup(m)})
		}
		enc.Encode(op{"cache": "modelGroups", "groups": groups})
	}

	// ---- codex
	{
		turn := func(id string, extra string) string {
			return `{"type":"cpa_codex_replay_turn","id":"` + id + `"` + extra + `}`
		}
		pool := []string{
			`{"type":"reasoning","summary":[1],"content":"x","encrypted_content":"` + gptSig(1) + `"}`,
			`{"type":"reasoning","encrypted_content":"` + gptSig(2) + `"}`,
			`{"type":"reasoning","encrypted_content":" ` + gptSig(3) + `"}`,
			`{"type":"reasoning","encrypted_content":"gAAAAnotvalid"}`,
			`{"type":"reasoning","encrypted_content":5}`,
			turn("t1", ""), turn("t2", `,"assistant_fingerprint":" fp ","request_fingerprint":"","call_ids":["a"," b ","",3]`),
			turn("t1", `,"call_ids":"x"`), turn(" ", ""), `{"type":"cpa_codex_replay_turn"}`,
			`{"type":"function_call","call_id":" c1 ","name":" f ","arguments":"{\"a\":1}"}`,
			`{"type":"function_call","call_id":"c2","name":"g","arguments":"a<b\"c"}`,
			`{"type":"function_call","call_id":"c3","name":"g","arguments":{"a":1}}`,
			`{"type":"function_call","name":"g","arguments":"{}"}`,
			`{"type":"custom_tool_call","call_id":"k1","name":"apply_patch","input":"*** Begin"}`,
			`{"type":"custom_tool_call","call_id":"k2","name":"x","input":{"a":[1,2]},"status":" in_progress "}`,
			`{"type":"custom_tool_call","call_id":"k3","name":"x"}`,
			`{"type":"custom_tool_call","call_id":"k4","name":"x","input":null}`,
			`{"type":"message","role":"assistant"}`, `not json`, `{}`,
		}
		for seq := 0; seq < 80; seq++ {
			ClearCodexReasoningReplayCache()
			var ops []op
			var outs []any
			for i := 0; i < 25; i++ {
				m, s := pick(models), pick(sessions)
				if rng.Intn(4) != 0 { // mostly valid scopes
					m, s = rng.Intn(2), rng.Intn(2)
				}
				items := []string{}
				for j := rng.Intn(5); j > 0; j-- {
					items = append(items, pool[rng.Intn(len(pool))])
				}
				base := op{"model": models[m], "session": sessions[s]}
				switch rng.Intn(7) {
				case 0, 1:
					base["op"], base["items"] = "cache", items
					outs = append(outs, CacheCodexReasoningReplayItems(models[m], sessions[s], toBytes(items)))
				case 2, 3:
					base["op"], base["items"] = "append", items
					outs = append(outs, AppendCodexReasoningReplayItemsBestEffort(ctx, models[m], sessions[s], toBytes(items)))
				case 4:
					base["op"] = "getItems"
					got, ok := GetCodexReasoningReplayItems(models[m], sessions[s])
					outs = append(outs, []any{strs(got), ok})
				case 5:
					base["op"] = "getItem"
					got, ok := GetCodexReasoningReplayItem(models[m], sessions[s])
					outs = append(outs, []any{string(got), ok})
				case 6:
					if rng.Intn(6) == 0 {
						base["op"] = "clear"
						ClearCodexReasoningReplayCache()
						outs = append(outs, nil)
					} else {
						base["op"] = "delete"
						DeleteCodexReasoningReplayItem(models[m], sessions[s])
						outs = append(outs, nil)
					}
				}
				ops = append(ops, base)
			}
			enc.Encode(op{"cache": "codex", "ops": ops, "out": outs})
		}
		// turn bounding: many turns
		ClearCodexReasoningReplayCache()
		var ops []op
		var outs []any
		for i := 0; i < CodexReasoningReplayCacheMaxTurnsPerEntry+5; i++ {
			items := []string{turn(fmt.Sprintf("turn-%d", i), ""), `{"type":"reasoning","encrypted_content":"` + gptSig(byte(i)) + `"}`}
			ops = append(ops, op{"op": "append", "model": "m1", "session": "s1", "items": items})
			outs = append(outs, AppendCodexReasoningReplayItemsBestEffort(ctx, "m1", "s1", toBytes(items)))
		}
		got, ok := GetCodexReasoningReplayItems("m1", "s1")
		ops = append(ops, op{"op": "getItems", "model": "m1", "session": "s1"})
		outs = append(outs, []any{strs(got), ok})
		enc.Encode(op{"cache": "codex", "ops": ops, "out": outs})
	}

	// ---- xai
	{
		g1, g2 := grokSig(100), grokSig(200)
		msg := func(role string, parts string) string {
			return `{"type":"message","role":"` + role + `","content":` + parts + `}`
		}
		pool := []string{
			`{"type":"reasoning","encrypted_content":"` + g1 + `"}`,
			`{"type":"reasoning","encrypted_content":"` + g2 + `","summary":[1]}`,
			`{"type":"reasoning","encrypted_content":"` + gptSig(1) + `"}`,
			`{"type":"reasoning","encrypted_content":" ` + g1 + `"}`,
			msg("assistant", `[{"type":"output_text","text":"hi <b>"},{"type":"refusal","refusal":"no"},{"type":"output_text","text":5},{"type":"image"}]`),
			msg(" Assistant ", `[{"type":"output_text","text":"a\"b"}]`),
			msg("user", `[{"type":"output_text","text":"hi"}]`),
			msg("assistant", `[]`), msg("assistant", `"str"`), msg("assistant", `[{"type":"refusal","refusal":3}]`),
			`{"type":"function_call","call_id":"c1","name":"f","arguments":"{}"}`,
			`{"type":"function_call","call_id":"","name":"f","arguments":"{}"}`,
			`{"type":"custom_tool_call","call_id":"k1","name":"x","input":{"q":1}}`,
			`{"type":"junk"}`, `bad`,
		}
		for seq := 0; seq < 60; seq++ {
			ClearXAIReasoningReplayCache()
			var ops []op
			var outs []any
			for i := 0; i < 20; i++ {
				m, s := rng.Intn(2), rng.Intn(2)
				if rng.Intn(8) == 0 {
					m, s = pick(models), pick(sessions)
				}
				items := []string{}
				for j := rng.Intn(5); j > 0; j-- {
					items = append(items, pool[rng.Intn(len(pool))])
				}
				base := op{"model": models[m], "session": sessions[s]}
				switch rng.Intn(5) {
				case 0, 1:
					base["op"], base["items"] = "store", items
					outs = append(outs, int(StoreXAIReasoningReplayItems(ctx, models[m], sessions[s], toBytes(items))))
				case 2:
					base["op"] = "getItems"
					got, ok := GetXAIReasoningReplayItems(models[m], sessions[s])
					outs = append(outs, []any{strs(got), ok})
				case 3:
					base["op"] = "getItem"
					got, ok := GetXAIReasoningReplayItem(models[m], sessions[s])
					outs = append(outs, []any{string(got), ok})
				case 4:
					base["op"] = "delete"
					DeleteXAIReasoningReplayItem(models[m], sessions[s])
					outs = append(outs, nil)
				}
				ops = append(ops, base)
			}
			enc.Encode(op{"cache": "xai", "ops": ops, "out": outs})
		}
	}

	// ---- antigravity
	{
		ts := func(sig string, extra string) string {
			return `{"type":"thought_signature","thoughtSignature":"` + sig + `"` + extra + `}`
		}
		pool := []string{
			ts("sig-aaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaa", `,"contentIndex":1,"partIndex":0`),
			ts("sig-bbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbb", `,"contentIndex":1.7,"partIndex":"x","targetKind":" text ","targetHash":" h ","targetOccurrence":2,"contextHash":"c"`),
			ts("sig-cccccccccccccccccccc", `,"targetKind":"other","targetOccurrence":-1`),
			ts("short", ``), ts("skip_thought_signature_validator", ``),
			`{"type":"thought_signature","thought_signature":"snake-dddddddddddddddddd"}`,
			`{"type":"thought_signature","thoughtSignature":"  ","thought_signature":"snake-eeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeee"}`,
			`{"type":"function_call_part","call_id":" c1 ","name":" f ","args":{"a":1},"thoughtSignature":" sigsig ","contentIndex":2,"partIndex":1,"targetOccurrence":0,"contextHash":" ch "}`,
			`{"type":"function_call_part","id":"i1","name":"f","args":"{\"a\":1}","thoughtSignature":"skip_thought_signature_validator"}`,
			`{"type":"function_call_part","functionCall":{"id":"fc1","name":"g","args":{"z":[1]}}}`,
			`{"type":"function_call_part","name":"g","functionCall":{"id":"fc2","args":null}}`,
			`{"type":"function_call_part","name":"g"}`,
			`{"type":"function_call_part","args":{}}`,
			`{"type":"junk"}`, `bad`,
		}
		for seq := 0; seq < 120; seq++ {
			ClearAntigravityReasoningReplayCache()
			var ops []op
			var outs []any
			snaps := make([]AntigravityReasoningReplaySnapshot, 3)
			for i := 0; i < 25; i++ {
				m, s := rng.Intn(2), rng.Intn(2)
				if rng.Intn(10) == 0 {
					m, s = pick(models), pick(sessions)
				}
				slot := rng.Intn(3)
				items := []string{}
				// favour chains so descendant/prefix logic is exercised
				for j := rng.Intn(4); j > 0; j-- {
					items = append(items, pool[rng.Intn(8)])
				}
				base := op{"model": models[m], "session": sessions[s], "slot": slot}
				switch rng.Intn(8) {
				case 0:
					base["op"], base["items"] = "cache", items
					outs = append(outs, CacheAntigravityReasoningReplayItems(models[m], sessions[s], toBytes(items)))
				case 1, 2:
					base["op"] = "snap"
					got, snap, found, e := GetAntigravityReasoningReplayItemsWithSnapshotRequired(ctx, models[m], sessions[s])
					snaps[slot] = snap
					outs = append(outs, []any{strs(got), found, e == nil})
				case 3, 4, 5:
					base["op"], base["items"] = "replace", items
					ok, e := ReplaceAntigravityReasoningReplayItemsIfUnchanged(ctx, models[m], sessions[s], snaps[slot], toBytes(items))
					outs = append(outs, []any{ok, errS(e)})
				case 6:
					base["op"] = "deleteIf"
					ok, e := DeleteAntigravityReasoningReplayItemsIfUnchanged(ctx, models[m], sessions[s], snaps[slot])
					outs = append(outs, []any{ok, errS(e)})
				case 7:
					if rng.Intn(3) == 0 {
						base["op"] = "getItems"
						got, ok := GetAntigravityReasoningReplayItems(models[m], sessions[s])
						outs = append(outs, []any{strs(got), ok})
					} else if rng.Intn(2) == 0 {
						base["op"] = "delete"
						DeleteAntigravityReasoningReplayItem(models[m], sessions[s])
						outs = append(outs, nil)
					} else {
						base["op"] = "getItem"
						got, ok := GetAntigravityReasoningReplayItem(models[m], sessions[s])
						outs = append(outs, []any{string(got), ok})
					}
				}
				ops = append(ops, base)
			}
			enc.Encode(op{"cache": "antigravity", "ops": ops, "out": outs})
		}
	}

	// ---- kimi + claude replay
	{
		pool := []string{
			`[{"type":"thinking","thinking":"a","signature":"s1"}]`,
			`[{"type":"thinking","thinking":"b","signature":"s2"},{"type":"tool_use","id":"t","name":"n","input":{"p":1}}]`,
			`[ {"signature":"s1","thinking":"a","type":"thinking"} ]`,
			`[{"type":"thinking","thinking":"a","signature":"s1"}]  `,
			`[{"n":1.0}]`, `[{"n":1}]`, `[{"s":"<>&"}]`, `[{"s":"<>&"}]`,
			`[]`, `{"a":1}`, `not json`, ``, `[1] trailing`,
		}
		for _, which := range []string{"kimi", "claude"} {
			for seq := 0; seq < 80; seq++ {
				ClearKimiThinkingReplayCache()
				ClearClaudeThinkingReplayCache()
				var ops []op
				var outs []any
				snaps := make([]KimiThinkingReplaySnapshot, 3)
				for i := 0; i < 25; i++ {
					m, s := rng.Intn(2), rng.Intn(2)
					if rng.Intn(10) == 0 {
						m, s = pick(models), pick(sessions)
					}
					slot := rng.Intn(3)
					content := pool[rng.Intn(len(pool))]
					base := op{"model": models[m], "session": sessions[s], "slot": slot, "content": content}
					switch rng.Intn(7) {
					case 0:
						base["op"] = "cache"
						if which == "kimi" {
							outs = append(outs, CacheKimiThinkingReplayBestEffort(ctx, models[m], sessions[s], []byte(content)))
						} else {
							outs = append(outs, CacheClaudeThinkingReplayBestEffort(ctx, models[m], sessions[s], []byte(content)))
						}
					case 1, 2:
						base["op"] = "snap"
						if which == "kimi" {
							got, snap, found, e := GetKimiThinkingReplayWithSnapshotRequired(ctx, models[m], sessions[s])
							snaps[slot] = snap
							outs = append(outs, []any{string(got), found, e == nil})
						} else {
							got, snap, found, e := GetClaudeThinkingReplayWithSnapshotRequired(ctx, models[m], sessions[s])
							snaps[slot] = snap
							outs = append(outs, []any{strs(got), found, e == nil})
						}
					case 3, 4:
						base["op"] = "replace"
						if which == "kimi" {
							ok, e := ReplaceKimiThinkingReplayIfUnchanged(ctx, models[m], sessions[s], snaps[slot], []byte(content))
							outs = append(outs, []any{ok, errS(e)})
						} else {
							ok, e := ReplaceClaudeThinkingReplayIfUnchanged(ctx, models[m], sessions[s], snaps[slot], []byte(content))
							outs = append(outs, []any{ok, errS(e)})
						}
					case 5:
						base["op"] = "deleteIf"
						if which == "kimi" {
							ok, e := DeleteKimiThinkingReplayIfUnchanged(ctx, models[m], sessions[s], snaps[slot])
							outs = append(outs, []any{ok, errS(e)})
						} else {
							ok, e := DeleteClaudeThinkingReplayIfUnchanged(ctx, models[m], sessions[s], snaps[slot])
							outs = append(outs, []any{ok, errS(e)})
						}
					case 6:
						if rng.Intn(2) == 0 {
							base["op"] = "get"
							if which == "kimi" {
								got, found, _ := GetKimiThinkingReplayRequired(ctx, models[m], sessions[s])
								outs = append(outs, []any{string(got), found})
							} else {
								got, found, _ := GetClaudeThinkingReplayRequired(ctx, models[m], sessions[s])
								outs = append(outs, []any{strs(got), found})
							}
						} else {
							base["op"] = "delete"
							if which == "kimi" {
								_ = DeleteKimiThinkingReplayRequired(ctx, models[m], sessions[s])
							} else {
								_ = DeleteClaudeThinkingReplayRequired(ctx, models[m], sessions[s])
							}
							outs = append(outs, nil)
						}
					}
					ops = append(ops, base)
				}
				enc.Encode(op{"cache": which, "ops": ops, "out": outs})
			}
		}
	}
}

func errS(err error) any {
	if err == nil {
		return nil
	}
	return err.Error()
}
